newsitem.title: CHINA: HK people ask China send troops to disputed isles.
newsitem.headline: HK people ask China send troops to disputed isles.

text.p: A group of Hong Kong legislators handed in a banner with 17,000 signatures to the Chinese Foreign Ministry on Thursday, urging Beijing to send warships to guard disputed islands in the East China Sea.

"We hope China will send troops to the Diaoyu islands to protect Chinese fishermen," Frederick Fung, a member of Hong Kong's Legislative Council and chairman of the Hong Kong Association for Democracy and People's Livelihood, said.

The six petitioners, including three legislators, were met by Wang Guisheng, director of the Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office of the Foreign Ministry, who received the banner containing the 17,000 signatures.
"Diaoyu islands are ours," Fung announced outside the Foreign Ministry, referring to China's claim to the islands, also claimed by Tokyo and Taipei.
